svg.aria-label: Architecture: a business user prompt flows through Azure AI Foundry (governed by API Management) to the copilot-sdk-service delivery API, which delegates to the GitHub Copilot cloud agent; the agent opens a pull request that deploys contoso-cart to Azure Container Apps. Every component exports telemetry through the OpenTelemetry Collector into Application Insights.
svg.text: FROM ONE PROMPT TO A LIVE, OBSERVED DEPLOYMENT
